jobs_results.title: SAP Developer Full-Stack (ABAP/ FIORI / BTP)
jobs_results.description:
As a leading consulting company for SAP software, especially for SAP S/4HANA transformations and SAP Cloud solutions, CNT Management Consulting has been one of the top international consultancies for 25 years. With 450 business process experts and SAP consultants in seven European countries as well as in the USA, we successfully support the digital transformation of corporations, mid-sized companies and public organizations. CNT Management Consulting offers method and consulting expertise for all SAP products.

What we offer you:
• Flexible working model: 100% flexible working time and location model, home office can be individually arranged.
• Variety of training opportunities: Active promotion of internal and external training, certifications, competence teams, and much more.
• International and inspiring working environment: Locations throughout Europe and in the USA, international projects and colleagues.
• Activities to support health and well-being: Offers that support health... sport, well-being (e.g. yoga, private supplementary insurance, and much more).
• Attractive compensation package: Financial security through high base salary, performance-related bonus, company car, subsidized public transport, nursery school and restaurant tickets.
• Employee participation and bonus systems: Various bonuses (e.g. headhunter bonus, sales bonus, new client bonus).
• Employee benefits: Variety of discounts on products or services from partner companies.
• Active participation and events: Contribution of your own ideas (My-Idea), numerous events (e.g. team events, Christmas party, sports events, etc.).

What your tasks are:
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy high-quality software solutions in SAP ABAP / FIORI / BTP projects.
• Engage in full-stack development: work with cutting-edge technologies to develop end-to-end solutions, spanning from server-based system functions to user interface implementation.
• You will be asked for efficient code writing according to SAP best practices and coding standards.
• Enhance your skills by own further trainings and actively participate in knowledge-sharing sessions of our CNT-competence team.

What experience you should have:
• successfully completed a degree in business informatics, a comparable field of study or an apprenticeship with an IT focus.
• know-how in ABAP, FIORI and BTP (SAP CAP) with approx. 3 years of experience
• Interest in project work and consulting and have experience in agile Development with Client Interaction.
• high flexibility and willingness to travel.
• business fluent in English.

CNT stands for further development, career opportunities and prospects, as well as a family-friendly working environment. With equal opportunities, diversity and a lived YOU culture, we ensure a productive and at the same time positive working relationship.

If you have any questions, please contact the following e-mail address: recruiting@cnt-online.com

We are looking forward to your application!

Regine Bartholomäus

Central Functions Specialist

Human Resources

jobs_results.description:
¡¡¡Estamos ampliando el equipo!!! ¡¡¡¡En Azertium IT te buscamos!!!! Nos urge incorporar un Desarrollador SAP ABAP con al menos 2 años de experiencia en el puesto y sector IT, para formar parte de nuestro equipo con grandes retos, trayectoria y crecimiento profesional.

Modalidad de trabajo 100% EN REMOTO.
• *Es necesario estar viviendo en España y tener permiso de trabajo (en caso de ser extranjero)**

Se requiere experiencia en las siguientes tecnologías:
• Experiencia trabajando con SAP ABAP.
• Conocimiento sobre código SAP y Templates
• Inglés alto (C1) para poder comunicarse a nivel internacional con otros equipos.

Las funciones a realizar son las siguientes:
• Desarrollar e identificar fallos de seguridad de aplicaciones de SAP.
• Auditar en sincronía de equipo de consultores de ciberseguridad, los repositorios y desarrollos de SAP.
• Diseño e implementación de formación de seguridad para desarrollo SAP.
• Diseño e implementación de un programa de desarrollo seguro.
•... Assessments de seguridad a soluciones SAP (aplicaciones, arquitecturas, sistemas...).
• Revisión de seguridad a proyectos relacionados con SAP.

Ofrecemos formación en ciberseguridad, contrato indefinido, desarrollo y flexibilidad laboral.

jobs_results.title: Analista Developer SAP ABAP
jobs_results.description:
Hola Consultores, S.L. es una empresa especializada en la provisión de Servicios TIC e Ingeniería para la gestión empresarial, ofreciendo soluciones diseñadas a medida de las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

Nos enorgullece ser una empresa 2.0 innovadora donde las personas son el centro de nuestra atención. La ética, transparencia, imparcialidad e independencia son valores fundamentales en nuestra filosofía, y también estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de género. Nos esforzamos por garantizar oportunidades equitativas para hombres y mujeres en todas las áreas de nuestro trabajo. Además, estamos firmemente a favor de la igualdad en todas sus formas y promovemos un entorno inclusivo donde cada individuo, independientemente de su género, religión, orientación sexual, etnia o cualquier otra característica, sea valorado y respetado.

📣Estamos en la búsqueda de perfiles Analista Developer SAP-ABAP para el sector Hotelero. 🏨

Responsabilidades:

- Liderar y coordinar equipos de... desarrollo en proyectos y evolutivos relacionados con SAP ABAP.

- Analizar los requerimientos del negocio y proponer soluciones técnicas eficientes y escalables.

- Gestionar proyectos y/o evolutivos, asegurando la entrega dentro de los plazos establecidos y cumpliendo con los estándares de calidad.

- Mantener un enfoque orientado a objetos en el desarrollo de soluciones para garantizar la modularidad y la reutilización del código.

- Implementar y mantener integraciones utilizando BAPI's, SAP Gateway y webservices.

- Realizar pruebas unitarias y de integración para garantizar la estabilidad y fiabilidad de las soluciones implementadas.

Requisitos mínimos:

- Experiencia mínima de 5 años como Analista Programador ABAP R3.

- Demostrada capacidad de liderazgo y gestión de equipos.

- Conocimientos sólidos en los módulos de FI, CO, MM y HCM.

- Familiaridad con BAPI's, SAP Gateway y webservices.

- Experiencia en proyectos de orientación a objetos.

- Dominio del idioma español.

Valorable:

- Conocimientos en los módulos de TMS, BW y PS.

- Experiencia en PO, CPI, Hana Cloud, BTP, Idocs y Fiori.

- Conocimientos en S/4 HANA.

❤️Beneficios:

🤝🏽Contrato laboral indefinido y estabilidad desde el primer día.

🚀Todo nuestro apoyo para tu desarrollo personal/profesional.

🕓Jornada laboral híbrida, 3X2

✍🏻Incorporación inmediata.

📍 Oficinas en el centro de Barcelona.

🥰Excelente clima laboral.

💊Seguro médico privado con Adeslas (completo + dental).

📕Pago del 100% exámenes de certificación oficial.

✔️Grandes proyectos con tecnologías avanzadas.

¡Estamos esperando conocerte! ¡En Hola Consultores apostamos por ti

jobs_results.title: SAP ABAP Engineer (FI-CA, FI-CI)
jobs_results.description:
Description

Looking for an opportunity to transform leading companies’ needs into excellent engineering solutions and drive innovation? Take your holistic expertise in ABAP application development and join EPAM SAP Practice uniting 2,200+ diverse professionals in 30+ countries. We are looking for a passionate Engineer with FICA/CI knowledge for our global retailer client’s BRIM project. In this role, you will be responsible for continuously improving the SAP system’s processes and code to better support the business.

Take the freedom to work remotely from anywhere across the country or meet with teammates in our office.

What You’ll Do
• Implement change requests and fix bugs in the BRIM area
• Contribute to the development of special ABAP requirements
• Assist functional stakeholders in error or process analysis such as debugging
• Participate in BRIM projects as a developer
• Help the team in monitoring FICA/CI activities
• Support functional stakeholders on standalone tasks such... as building queries to foster data

What You Have
• Proficiency in SAP S4 / HANA environments
• Expert knowledge in ABAP Object Oriented
• Solid technical experience in FICA/CI
• Understanding of security, efficient code reuse and software design
• Fluency in English (B2 and above), both written and verbal

Nice to have
• Knowledge of AIF
• Skills in SAP ALE and Idocs
• Understanding of BRF+
• Experience in SAP O-Data, REST

We Offer
• WORK & LIFE BALANCE. Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible & remote work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays
• CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE. Develop your hard & soft skills with internal training and mentorship opportunities, sponsored professional certification, and access to 18,000+ LinkedIn courses
• CLEAR & DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS. Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager
• GLOBAL RELOCATION OPPORTUNITIES. EPAM has presence in more than 50 countries globally. Explore opportunities to relocate to a new country, and EPAM will provide relocation support for you and your family
• COMPETITIVE BENEFITS. Benefit from a competitive salary, private health insurance, employee stock purchase plan, special discount programs, plus, internal wellbeing programs to take your career to the next level
• STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY. Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends

About EPAM
• EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company. With over 53,150 EPAMers in more than 55 countries and regions, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In Spain, EPAM has over 1,450 EPAMers working remotely across the country as well as in the Málaga and Madrid offices. Since 1996, EPAM has been a strategic SAP partner. We have helped over 150+ customers seamlessly transform operations with SAP products for improved client interactions and growth. Our expertise spans various SAP technologies: S/4HANA, Business Technology Platform (BTP), Financial Management, CRM & Customer Experience, Supply Chain Management, Spend Management, and Human Capital Management solutions.

EPAM’s global SAP community unites over 2,500 engineers and consultants who work on international projects for industry leaders while taking advantage of the SAP-tailored learning opportunities and engaging in collaborative discussions on SAP technologies, best practices, and industry trends to keep pace with the ever-evolving SAP landscape. Empower your SAP journey with EPAM – join us in Spain! Apply

jobs_results.title: SAP ABAP Developer
jobs_results.description:
Eviden, part of the Atos Group, with an annual revenue of circa € 5 billion is a global leader in data-driven, trusted and sustainable digital transformation. As a next generation digital business with worldwide leading positions in digital, cloud, data, advanced computing and security, it brings deep expertise for all industries in more than 47 countries. By uniting unique high-end technologies across the full digital continuum with 53,000 world-class talents, Eviden expands the possibilities of data and technology, now and for generations to come.

Eviden Spain is looking for a SAP ABAP Developer:

What Impact You Can Make:

As an ABAP Developer at Eviden Spain, you will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our SAP systems, ensuring their optimal performance and functionality. Your expertise will directly contribute to enhancing our operations, streamlining processes, and ultimately driving business success.

Role and Responsibilities:
• Develop, customize, and... maintain SAP ABAP programs and reports according to business requirements.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand system needs and translate them into technical solutions.
• Perform unit testing and debugging to ensure the reliability and efficiency of developed programs.
• Support system enhancements, upgrades, and integrations, adhering to best practices and standards.

jobs_results.title: SAP Integration Developer
jobs_results.description:
Hicron is a Polish IT integrator focused on providing enterprise-level IT services. We serve customers in more than 20 countries on 4 continents delivering top-level systems and solutions. We have a team of more than 300 experts in IT consulting, software development, quality assurance, IT process, and project management. You can learn more about us at http://www.hicron.com.

We are looking for a SAP Integration Developer to join our SAP Technology Team!

Your Challenges
• Participation in the implementation and development projects in SAP Integration area.
• Actively support tasks at each stage of the project, including functional and technical specifications, configuration of the SAP system, execution of programming tasks, conducting module and integration tests, and supporting the customer during the go-live of the new solution.
• Participation in the development of dedicated HICRON solutions in the SAP Integration area.
• Willingness to develop programming competencies.
•... Cooperation with foreign clients.
• Work with customer and business consultants.

Our expectations
• Minimum of 5 years' experience working in SAP integration environment.
• Very good knowledge of SAP PO/PI.
• Good knowledge of SAP Cloud Integration Suite (CPI).
• Communicative English in writing and speaking.
• Strong analytical skills and drive to find solutions.
• Ability to learn quickly and willingness to develop in SAP technologies.
• Knowledge of ABAP including ABAP OO.

Nice to have
• Communicative German in writing and speaking.
• Willingness to travel on business (10-30%).

What we offer
• Possibility of development and certification and access to a full range of training materials – SAP Learning Hub.
• Work in an organization open to employee feedback, where communication at every level is open and processes do not limit creativity.
• Individual training budget.
• Integration events

jobs_results.title: Analista Programador en Desarrollo SAP - Abap/4
jobs_results.description:
Estamos buscando un Analista Programador SAP ABAP/4 experimentado para unirse a nuestro equipo en Bizkaia, España. Este proyecto te brindará la oportunidad de trabajar con algunas de las tecnologías más avanzadas y en un entorno de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo.

Rol

Analista Programador en Desarrollo SAP - Abap/4

Detalles Del Puesto

Experiencia mínima de cinco (5) años.

Flexibilidad horaria con turnos habituales de 8h a 13:30h y de 15h a 18h.

Posibilidad de teletrabajo.

Responsabilidades: Realización de análisis técnico, programación, pruebas, y debugging bajo la especificación de un consultor o el cliente.

Conocimientos Requeridos

Conocimientos en: Expertise en Abap/4, Programación OO, Smartforms, AdobeForms, IDOCs, Webdynpro, Webservices, Workflow, Archivelink, GOS, archivados, y conocimiento funcional en QM.

Buscamos un/a profesional con gran capacidad de trabajo en equipo, proactividad y una actitud positiva.

¡Aplica ahora y forma parte de nuestro equipo!

Fomentamos... un ambiente de trabajo multicultural e inclusivo, no discriminamos por edad, género o creencias; así como ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todo el personal.

Desarrollamos nuestras actividades bajo los principios del cuidado del medioambiente, la sostenibilidad y la responsabilidad social corporativa; colaborando en proyectos de reforestación y sostenibilidad.

Apoyamos los 10 principios del Pacto Mundial y los 17 Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible, en materia de derechos humanos, condiciones laborales, medio ambiente y anticorrupción.

Los procesos de reclutamiento se desarrollan bajo altos estándares de calidad definiendo la incorporación en base a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Somos una empresa española líder en servicios tecnológicos y atracción del talento presente en el mercado desde 1995. Contamos con más de 600 empleados en proyectos tanto nacionales como internacionales en sector
